timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision (same encoding as run-trace events).

description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the derivative ClaudeAgents run-trace index (T1 F1.3). The index is a fast-read summary so readers do not have to scan every event file; it is regenerable by scanning the self-describing event files and sorting by sequence number, and may lag the events (readers MUST treat events as authoritative when the index disagrees). countByClass keys are the eventType discriminator strings; per the forward-compatibility contract a new event-class type adds a new key without bumping the schema, so countByClass permits additional camelCase keys. The run disposition is set when the run terminates and is absent on an in-progress run.

countByClass.description: Per-event-class counts keyed on the eventType discriminator. Open map: a new event class adds a key without a schema bump (forward-compatibility contract). Keys are camelCase ASCII.

disposition.description: Run/sprint outcome, set when the run terminates. Absent while the run is in progress.

title: ClaudeAgents run-trace index, v1
